facts.fact: Emily 说 JJ 的真名是 Liam Craig，二十五岁，比他们以为的大得多。
facts.anchor: he’s Liam Craig and he’s twenty-five

facts.fact: Emily 趁 JJ 在麦当劳门外时偷看了他钱包里的驾照，随后原样放回。
facts.anchor: I only sneaked a very quick look, while he was outside McDonald’s.

facts.fact: Emily 提议趁 JJ 外出搜他房间，找 Liam Craig 的线索；Matty 起初想先确认再行动，最后还是同意了。
facts.anchor: we’ll search through his room and see if we can find more intel on Liam Craig

facts.fact: 三天后 JJ 出门去见一群名字体面的朋友，搜房的机会来了。
facts.anchor: He was going out to meet friends with names like Ollie, Charlie and Harry.

facts.fact: JJ 的房间一尘不染，墙上只有 Oasis 和 The Stone Roses 的海报，没有任何家人朋友的照片。
facts.anchor: Everything was immaculate and the room betrayed little personality.

facts.fact: Matty 在书桌抽屉里翻到一封收件人写作 Liam Craig 的信，与满抽屉写给 Jake Jeffreyes 的信不同。
facts.anchor: This one was not addressed to Jake Jeffreyes, but to Liam Craig.

facts.fact: 信封背面的寄件人是 Norwich Crown Court，Emily 由此认定 JJ 是危险人物。
章末 Matty 一边给 Emily 倒酒一边说，不管怎样他都会保护她。
